**Binding a newly provisioned DID into existing IVR**

- The CINNOX IVR orchestrator supports hot-binding a new DID to an existing call flow without republishing the entire IVR tree.
- Flow: IVR Editor → Select existing flow → 'Inbound DID' panel → '+ Add number' → pick the newly activated DID → Save.
- Effective within 60 seconds; no impact on in-flight calls on other DIDs bound to the same flow.
